page_title: FRE 1-1 DOR | Freiburg v Dortmund 14/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) is given a yellow card.
90+5' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
90+4' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is behind the touchline and Dortmund will take a throw-in.
90+4' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
90+3' Niko Kovac has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Niklas Sule (Dortmund) replacing Emre Can.
90+2' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) will replace Yan Couto.

90+1' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Pascal Gross was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Corner kicks – 6:0.
90' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
89' Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) collects an inch-perfect pass and strikes the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked.
88' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Freiburg due to an offside in the build-up play.
87' Attention! Referee Felix Zwayer straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
86' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
86' Corner kick. Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) is ready to send the ball into the box.
85' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.
84' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) makes a good run to latch onto the free kick from Vincenzo Grifo, but pushes his close-range header high over the bar.
83' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.

82' A rebound on the edge of the box falls to the feet of the unmarked Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg). He doesn't hesitate and shoots towards goal, but unfortunately for him it hits one of his own teammates. Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and drills a shot to the middle of the goal, but is denied by a reflex save from Gregor Kobel.
82' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
81' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
79' The attendance is 34700.
78' Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
78' Substitution. Carney Chukwuemeka makes his way off the pitch and Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) comes on as his replacement.
78' A substitution has been made. Serhou Guirassy goes off and Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) comes on.
76' Julian Schuster has decided to substitute Christian Gunter and he is replaced by Igor Matanovic (Freiburg).
76' Substitution. Anthony Jung walks off the pitch and Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) comes on as a substitute.
75' 1 - 1 Lucas Holer (Freiburg) produces a superb finish after connecting with a cross and unleashing a first-time volley towards goal that goes in off the right post!
75' 14:9 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The current number of shots on goal is 4:4.
73' Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) didn't hesitate to shoot from around the penalty spot and aimed towards the top of the net. Gregor Kobel was alert, made a superb save and parried the ball onto the bar.
72' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
71' Philipp Treu (Freiburg) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Gregor Kobel intercepts the ball.
70' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) takes it short.
70' Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear. Now Freiburg have a corner.

69' Philipp Treu (Freiburg) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the roof of the net. Gregor Kobel pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. Freiburg earn a corner.
69' Some neat passing and movement from Freiburg as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
66' Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
65' Golden opportunity! Philipp Treu (Freiburg) lost his marker inside the box, only to shoot just wide of the left post after receiving a good pass.
61' A player from Freiburg commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
59' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
58' A header by Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) from very close range goes straight at Gregor Kobel, who makes a nice save.
58' Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
56' Forced substitution due to red card. Pascal Gross (Dortmund) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Fabio Silva.
55' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) strikes the ball from a direct free kick on the edge of the box. His shot only goes narrowly wide of the left post.
54' Freiburg are awarded a free kick on the edge of the box.
53' Jobe Bellingham (Dortmund) reacts stupidly and the referee shows him a deserved red card!
53' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) tries an acrobatic volley inside the box that disappears way over the bar.
52' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Gregor Kobel.
51' Yan Couto (Dortmund) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
49' Fabio Silva receives a short pass from Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund), but the opposition's defence thwarts his effort.
48' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) commits a foul and Felix Zwayer immediately signals a free kick.
46' Referee Felix Zwayer blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' Jobe Bellingham (Dortmund) meets a precise pass with a nice touch on the edge of the box and produces a shot to the middle of the goal. What an excellent save by the goalkeeper!
45+2' Yan Couto (Dortmund) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the left post. Noah Atubolu is alert and denies him with a nice save.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Good chance! Yuito Suzuki laid the ball off to Christian Gunter (Freiburg) inside the box, he ducked inside his man and rifled a shot in at goal that skimmed the top of the bar.
45' Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) takes a short corner kick.

45' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The ball goes behind for a corner. Freiburg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
42' Yan Couto (Dortmund) takes a short free kick.
41' Felix Zwayer blows his whistle and signals a foul after Christian Gunter (Freiburg) brought his opponent down. Dortmund have a free kick.
39' Johan Manzambi rounds off a good move with a layoff to Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) inside the box, he has a clear sight of goal but sends the ball just wide of the left post.
37' Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
37' Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.

35' Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
34' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Freiburg earn a free kick.
33' The total number of attempts is 3:6. The shots on goal statistics – 1:2.
31' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) wins the ball inside the penalty area after the free kick and scores with a precise shot inside the left post!
31' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Felix Zwayer signals. A free kick is awarded to Dortmund.
30' Excellent touch by Christian Gunter (Freiburg)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box but miskicks and the ball goes well wide of the right post. Poor effort.
26' The corner kick from Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

25' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat. Freiburg force a corner. They send men into the box.

25' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Freiburg.

24' Emre Can (Dortmund) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the left post. Noah Atubolu pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
23' Philipp Treu (Freiburg) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
21' Carney Chukwuemeka (Dortmund) storms into the box to get on the end of a pass, but smashes his shot straight onto the left post. Unlucky!
20' Yan Couto (Dortmund) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
17' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) anticipates the cross from Felix Nmecha, but powers his header way over the bar from the edge of the six-yard box.
16' The ratio of the ball possession is 36:64.
13' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Dortmund.
11' This is a yellow card! Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
11' Yan Couto (Dortmund) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
9' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) tries to find Philipp Treu, but he puts too much power on the pass.

9' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Gregor Kobel makes a decent save to deny his effort directed to the bottom left corner.
9' Yan Couto (Dortmund) sends a cross into the box, but Noah Atubolu comes off his line to gather the ball.
8' Great teamplay by Dortmund as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
5' Great ball in from Yan Couto. Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) should really have done better with a close-range header, but he heads it a whisker wide of the left post.
5' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
5' Yan Couto (Dortmund) takes a cheeky throw-in and sets up a counter-attack for his team.

2' Anthony Jung (Freiburg) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Felix Zwayer with no other option than to blow for a foul.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Dortmund will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Felix Zwayer.
